summary: VS MEDIA Holdings Ltd furnished a Form 6-K on October 1, 2026, providing unaudited interim consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, plus related MD&A, incorporated by reference into its Form F-3 and Form S-8 registration statements. Revenue rose 3.0% to $3,357,924 and gross profit improved 12.2%, while operating expenses fell 77.7%, narrowing net loss 94.3% to $254,213. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer interim reporting filing, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor apply.
